data.about: A symmetric two-span continuous beam under a uniform load. Each span's load is bundled into a resultant, and the funicular tent through the three supports is drawn with a draggable apex — its mirror image serves the second span. The two span poles in the force diagram follow from the string directions, and the vertical distance between them is exactly the middle reaction B. Eight strips per span refine the tent into the true parabolic funicular, and mirroring it across the beam line yields the bending-moment diagram with its hogging peak over the middle support.

steps.caption: step through with the slider, press play, or use ←/→
steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: left: a beam over two equal spans — a pin at A, rollers under B and C — carrying a uniform load q (green band); by symmetry everything on the right span will mirror the left
steps.title: Two spans, three supports

steps.caption: left: each span’s load is bundled into its resultant R₁ (and its mirror R₂) acting on the span middle line — right: the load line: R₁, R₂ stacked tip-to-tail
steps.title: Each span as one resultant

steps.caption: left: strings from A₁ up to the apex (DRAG it — and the sag point I over B): A₁ → apex → I → mirror → C₁ — right: parallels through the load-line ends locate the span poles H and V
steps.title: The funicular tent

steps.caption: right: the two poles H and V lie on one vertical — and the piece between them IS the middle reaction B; the horizontal through H cuts the load line at J: A_V above, and C closes below (offset arrows beside the line)
steps.title: B is the distance between the poles

steps.caption: right: each resultant divides into eight strip loads with rays to its pole — left: the strip funicular walks station by station, inscribed in the tent: the true parabola of the distributed load
steps.title: Eight strips per span

steps.caption: left: mirror the parabolas across the beam line (red): the bending-moment diagram — sagging in the spans, and the hogging spike over the middle support B
steps.title: The moment diagram

steps.caption: right: mirror the whole force diagram across the load line (red): the same construction read from the right — B appears twice, once per reading: the symmetry closes
steps.title: The symmetric check

steps.caption: drag the apex, the sag I, the load-line anchor or the R1 slider — the tent, the poles, B and the moment diagram follow; click a support or apex for its equilibrium
steps.title: Done
